entities.summary: Rowan Varty is a British-born Hong Kong former rugby union player. He is the all-time top point scorer for the Hong Kong national rugby union team, whom he also captained. Additionally, he represented the Hong Kong Sevens team and was selected to play for the Barbarians. His sister, Lindsay, represents Hong Kong in the rugby sevens women's team.
